title: Quadratic operation-presentation governance

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Human-approved 20-slice governance and exemplar revision with publication excluded and a renewed checkpoint at slice 20.
Existing quadratic target whose rejected publication tail this contract replaces.

allowedWork: Quadratic operation-presentation certificates, atomic trace compilation, material roles, phase and motif conformance, compressed causal chains, exact drill-down, both method projections, route ratchets, tests, visual evidence, and Theseus records.
Presentation-only simplification from semantic solution-set reunion to direct branch-to-graph handoff while retaining semantic, accessibility, inspection, root, and graph authority.
disallowedWork: No Workbench publication, family-wide promotion, unrelated roadmap domain, CAS, broad renderer redesign, or reuse of the radical animation WebGL workaround.
Do not alter accepted quadratic math, root and branch identity, graph authority, shared clock, review lifecycle, or unrelated user-authored changes.
goal: Certify and rebuild both quadratic algebra methods as operation-specific compressed causal traces with exact drill-down and direct branch-to-graph continuity, then stop for renewed human review.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with its Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: H1 HUMAN-EXEMPLAR: stop at slice 20 for explicit visual approval.
H2 MATH: stop on unverified algebra, inexact canonical results, or presentation-owned mathematical truth.
H3 CAUSALITY: stop if a visible transformation lacks total operation coverage, material roles, phase order, or a registered motif.
H4 COMPRESSION: stop if contextual speed-up omits an operation or drill-down diverges from the canonical trace.
H5 PRESERVATION: stop on accepted graph, branch, route, review, accessibility, native settlement, seek, rewind, or baseline drift.
H6 OWNERSHIP: stop if a renderer must invent operations, correspondence, timing authority, or semantic identity.
H7 RADICAL-ISOLATION: stop if the quadratic fix requires the radical animation WebGL path or changes its known residual.
H8 SCOPE: stop before Workbench publication, family-wide generalization, another roadmap domain, a CAS, or broad renderer redesign.
H9 USER-OVERLAP: stop if required work cannot be separated from unrelated user-authored changes.
H10 VERIFICATION: stop if a required gate fails without a bounded in-scope repair.

slices.title: Rejected-checkpoint-and-preservation-ledger
slices.summary: Made the rejected checkpoint durable: notes 13-20, accepted semantic/branch/graph/runtime boundaries, rejected generic motion/compound omission/visible reunion, successor contract, and renewed human-approval publication gate are typed and tested; proposal and checkpoint records now agree.

slices.title: Operation-presentation-certificate-schema
slices.summary: Added and verified a renderer-neutral operation-presentation certificate schema binding authority operations, visible material roles, source/target states, motifs, choreography phases, and atomic or explicit compound spans without DOM, SVG, pixel, or keyframe authority.

slices.title: Operation-coverage-laws
slices.summary: Added exact operation-coverage laws: every authority operation must appear once in semantic order, and compound spans may cover only one contiguous authority interval; focused adversarial tests cover omissions, duplication, reorder, and skipped operations.

slices.title: Total-material-role-classification
slices.summary: Added total material-role laws that prevent the original all-symbol arc failure: visible material cannot be omitted, continuants reserve or reflow and never execute, focal and operation-result material must act, and structural ink remains inert.

slices.title: Phase-and-motif-conformance-laws
slices.summary: Added phase and motif conformance: spans preserve orient-reflow-act-settle-release order, continuants move before focal action, introduced material reserves space, every span acts, and motifs must be registered for each covered canonical operation.

slices.title: Generic-checkpoint-negative-fixture
slices.summary: Added the live rejected quadratic negative fixture. The current generic checkpoint asset still passes semantic and clock laws, but its observed all-token arc is now deterministically rejected for operand-like continuants, missing reflow, and an unregistered generic motif.

slices.title: Compressed-causal-chain-contract
slices.summary: Added compressed causal-chain planning for contextual algebra: the same dependency-ordered atomic actions power full and sped-up presentations, every operation retains a distinct disclosed segment and visible minimum, and grouped endpoint replacement cannot pass.

slices.title: Exact-parent-child-drilldown-contract
slices.summary: Added exact causal-chain drill-down: Show steps can only expand the same operation trace from compressed context to full detail, while a nested child clock leaves the parent paused and closing restores the identical elapsed time and progress.

slices.title: Quadratic-authority-to-presentation-adapter
slices.summary: Replaced generic quadraticSemanticCheckpoint transform authority with verified method-edge operation refs plus explicit branch and reunion operations, preserving total source/target correspondence, semantic identity, shared clock, seek, rewind, and serialization.

slices.title: Completing-square-balance-choreography
slices.summary: Rebuilt balance choreography so x², −5x, and equality are continuants that finish reflow before action; the relocated six is the sole focal operand and sole arcing owner. Native KaTeX endpoints, direct seek, responsive reader, review, accepted branches, and graph remain stable.

slices.title: Completing-square-both-sides-chain
slices.summary: Expanded the coarse completion jump into native, dependency-ordered add-both-sides, common-denominator, and fraction-merge operations. Dedicated deterministic review frames and a browser lane-separation law prove the arithmetic is depicted while outer timing and accepted endpoints remain stable.

slices.title: Perfect-square-factor-recognition
slices.summary: Expanded perfect-square recognition into an explicit a²−2ab+b² state and a reverse-distribution factor collapse with role-owned native KaTeX motion. Replaced unreadable full-tree crossfade with a measured midpoint ownership handoff.

slices.title: Square-root-and-isolate-x-chain
slices.summary: Added an exact four-operation post-factor derivation, native square-root/plus-minus/isolation/candidate states, and a continuous ownership handoff from the shared candidate into the two existing signed branches.

slices.title: Formula-substitution-choreography
slices.summary: Bound formula substitution to its authority operation, split signed/grouped coefficient selectors from stable formula structure, and staged continuant reflow before five focal substitutions in native KaTeX.

slices.title: Dependency-ordered-discriminant-evaluation
slices.summary: Decomposed discriminant evaluation into exact authority-owned power, product, subtraction, and denominator operations, each with a native selector-owned state and ordered motion.

slices.title: Radical-and-candidate-evaluation
slices.summary: Added exact numerator and division sub-operations, native radical collapse, explicit 4/2 and 6/2 candidates, exact 2 and 3 endpoints, and a stable root-to-branch handoff without touching the radical WebGL path.
